/api/discovery-feed.description: Used as an SWR Infinite cache key in DiscoveryFeed.tsx (~L150). The custom fetcher (`fetchDiscoveryPage`) actually calls `/api/campaigns` or `/api/influencers` under the hood. No standalone `/api/discovery-feed` route exists or is required.

details.actionableRecommendation: Harmless virtual cache key. Document in route matrix to prevent false-positive alarms.

/api/telemetry/event.description: Unhardened duplicate endpoint removed. Telemetry ingestion consolidated into hardened `/api/telemetry/track` with 2KB stream cap and strict origin verification.

/api/upload/confirm.description: Route exists at `src/app/api/upload/confirm/route.ts` to perform post-upload magic-byte security scans on presigned S3/R2 uploads. Current frontend upload flow in ProfileTab.tsx uses direct `/api/upload` multipart stream.

details.actionableRecommendation: Keep route intact as security post-verification hook for presigned uploads.
